instruction.text:
Yesterday, there was a conflict between Lynn and Elijah.
Drag the four images into the correct order to tell the story.

hint.text: Select each image to hear what is happening.

atoms.sound: At first, Elijah was playing with the toy bunny by himself.
Lynn tried to take the bunny from Elijah. She wanted to play with it too.
Then, they both explained how they felt and listened to each other.
Finally, they decided to share the toy and play together.

instruction.text:
Later that day there was another conflict between Lynn and Elijah.
Drag the four images into the correct order to tell the story.

hint.text: Select each image to hear what is happening.

atoms.sound: Elijah turned on some music, but Lynn wanted to play in silence.
To calm down, Lynn first took a deep breath and counted to ten.
When she was a bit calmer, she decided she could just play in another room.
That way they both got what they wanted. Elijah could listen to music, and Lynn could play where it was quiet.
